entities.description: Emperor of the Sun Empire on Ixalan, father of Caztaca and Apatzec Intli IV.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The Ixalan empire ruled by Intli.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: Intli's first child, Apex Priest of the Threefold Sun.

entities.name: Atlacan Huicintli

entities.name: Apatzec Intli I
entities.description: Emperor who abused the Immortal Sun to conquer the River Heralds.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact sought by the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Warrior poet whose visions convinced Intli Orazca would be found.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: City the Immortal Sun was sought in.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Intli led the defense and died.

events.summary: Intli succeeds his long-lived mother and launches the empire into a renaissance and turmoil.
events.quote: launching the empire into a renaissance state

events.summary: Huatli's visions convince Intli that Orazca will be found and he commits resources to the search.
events.quote: Learning of the visions of the warrior poet Huatli , though, convinced him that Orazca would be found

events.summary: After Orazca is captured, Intli pushes the invaders to the sea and captures their fleet to prepare invading Torrezon.
events.quote: Apatzec began a campaign that pushed the invaders to the sea

events.summary: Intli names his infant son Intli IV successor instead of Caztaca.
events.quote: Intli named him successor instead of Caztaca

events.summary: Intli leads the defense against the Phyrexians and is assassinated by sleeper agents; Intli IV succeeds him.
events.quote: He was assassinated by Phyrexian sleeper agents near the end of the invasion

events.summary: In his will Intli legitimizes Atlacan as his paper son.
events.quote: In his will, he legitimized Atlacan as his "paper son,"
